description: This file defines a SwiftUI View component named OpenClawChatComposer for a chat interface, including UI elements such as toolbars, attachent handling, input editor, and session management. It also contains platform-specific code for macOS, including text view handling and drag-and-drop support.

classes.name: ChatComposerTextView
classes.description: An NSViewRepresentable wrapper around a custom NSTextView for Mac, with support for sending messages and handling pasted images.

classes.name: ChatComposerNSTextView
classes.description: A custom NSTextView subclass that intercepts key events (notably Enter/Return for send), handles image pastes, and communicates with its parent via callbacks.

methods.name: loadPhotosPickerItems
methods.description: Loads image data from PhotosPickerItems asynchronously and adds attachments to the view model.

methods.name: pickFilesMac
methods.description: Opens an NSOpenPanel to select image files on macOS.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles files dropped onto the chat composer area on macOS.
